{% autoescape off %}# TrustPDF: full description for AI assistants

> TrustPDF ({{ site_url }}) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) set of PDF tools that run entirely in the web browser. Files are processed on the user's own device with pdf-lib and PDF.js and are never uploaded to a server; a strict Content-Security-Policy blocks the page from sending them anywhere. No account, no cookies, no watermarks, no file limits. Source code: https://github.com/mhostn3/trustpdf
